evidence.target_model: SCAN sequence model; BabyAI policy; ImageNet ResNet-18; independently trained ViTs
evidence.intervention: Frozen LLM writes a reusable executable program p(W,I), without gradient training.
evidence.claim: SCAN exact match 0% → 99.8% (257 weights); BabyAI pickup 0% → 98.4%; image robustness gains reported.
evidence.baselines: Eight fine-tuning comparisons on ImageNet with matched information and preservation constraints.
evidence.preservation: SCAN prior commands remain 99.6%; sequential ViT updates preserve earlier installed robustness within reported tolerance.
evidence.transfer: Ten programs rerun on 5 independently trained ViTs retain 83–110% of source gain; copying ΔW does not.
evidence.caveat: Evidence is reported for tested model families/tasks, not general foundation-model transfer.

entries.title: The Role of Permutation Invariance in Linear Mode Connectivity of Neural Networks
entries.render_en: - **[The Role of Permutation Invariance in Linear Mode Connectivity of Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.06296)** (2021 preprint). **Weight-centric idea:** Examines how neuron permutation symmetry changes comparisons between solutions. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Weight readers and portable programs need a symmetry-aware account of parameter identity.

entries.title: Weight-space symmetry in deep networks gives rise to permutation saddles, connected by equal-loss valleys across the loss landscape
entries.render_en: - **[Weight-space symmetry in deep networks gives rise to permutation saddles, connected by equal-loss valleys across the loss landscape](https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.02911)** (2019). **Weight-centric idea:** Permutation-equivalent minima can be connected through symmetry-induced saddle regions. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Portable edits must respect functional equivalence, not raw neuron indices.

entries.title: Improved Generalization of Weight Space Networks via Augmentations
entries.render_en: - **[Improved Generalization of Weight Space Networks via Augmentations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04081)** (2024). **Weight-centric idea:** Weight-space augmentation and MixUp reduce overfitting of networks trained on other networks. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Train or test weight readers against symmetry and checkpoint-distribution shortcuts.
entries.render_zh: - **[Improved Generalization of Weight Space Networks via Augmentations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04081)**（2024）。**核心思路：**利用权重空间数据增强与 MixUp 改善模型对模型的学习泛化。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**权重读取器应经过对称变化和检查点分布偏移测试。
entries.idea_en: Weight-space augmentation and MixUp reduce overfitting of networks trained on other networks.
entries.idea_zh: 利用权重空间数据增强与 MixUp 改善模型对模型的学习泛化。
entries.inspiration_en: Train or test weight readers against symmetry and checkpoint-distribution shortcuts.
entries.inspiration_zh: 权重读取器应经过对称变化和检查点分布偏移测试。

entries.title: Understanding Mode Connectivity via Parameter Space Symmetry
entries.render_en: - **[Understanding Mode Connectivity via Parameter Space Symmetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23681)** (ICML 2025). **Weight-centric idea:** Relates low-loss connectivity to continuous parameter symmetries. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Check whether edits preserve or leave a stable functional neighborhood.
entries.render_zh: - **[Understanding Mode Connectivity via Parameter Space Symmetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23681)**（ICML 2025）。**核心思路：**用连续参数对称性分析低损失解之间的连通性。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**检查权重更新是否偏离宿主网络的稳定功能区域。
entries.idea_en: Relates low-loss connectivity to continuous parameter symmetries.

entries.title: Generalized Linear Mode Connectivity for Transformers
entries.render_en: - **[Generalized Linear Mode Connectivity for Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.22712)** (2025). **Weight-centric idea:** Studies broader alignment and connectivity conditions for Transformer checkpoints. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Derive host-aware alignment rules before transferring weight programs.
entries.render_zh: - **[Generalized Linear Mode Connectivity for Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.22712)**（2025）。**核心思路：**研究 Transformer 检查点更一般的对齐及线性连通条件。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**跨 Transformer 复用权重程序前应考虑结构与对齐。
entries.idea_en: Studies broader alignment and connectivity conditions for Transformer checkpoints.
entries.idea_zh: 研究 Transformer 检查点更一般的对齐及线性连通条件。
entries.inspiration_en: Derive host-aware alignment rules before transferring weight programs.
entries.inspiration_zh: 跨 Transformer 复用权重程序前应考虑结构与对齐。

entries.title: Beyond the Permutation Symmetry of Transformers: The Role of Rotation for Model Fusion
entries.render_en: - **[Beyond the Permutation Symmetry of Transformers: The Role of Rotation for Model Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.00264)** (ICML 2025). **Weight-centric idea:** Highlights rotation symmetries beyond simple neuron permutations. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Cross-model edits may need basis-aware transformations.
entries.render_zh: - **[Beyond the Permutation Symmetry of Transformers: The Role of Rotation for Model Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.00264)**（ICML 2025）。**核心思路：**指出 Transformer 的模型融合还涉及置换之外的旋转对称性。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**跨模型编辑可能需要对基变换保持一致。

entries.title: Universal Neural Functionals
entries.render_en: - **[Universal Neural Functionals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.05232)** (NeurIPS 2024). **Weight-centric idea:** Builds symmetry-aware functions over parameters across network architectures. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Motivates readers and edit locators designed around valid parameter symmetries.
entries.render_zh: - **[Universal Neural Functionals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.05232)**（NeurIPS 2024）。**核心思路：**构造适用于多类网络架构的对称感知参数函数。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**启发设计遵循重参数化对称性的读取器与定位器。
entries.idea_en: Builds symmetry-aware functions over parameters across network architectures.
entries.idea_zh: 构造适用于多类网络架构的对称感知参数函数。
entries.inspiration_en: Motivates readers and edit locators designed around valid parameter symmetries.
entries.inspiration_zh: 启发设计遵循重参数化对称性的读取器与定位器。

entries.title: Monomial Matrix Group Equivariant Neural Functional Networks
entries.render_en: - **[Monomial Matrix Group Equivariant Neural Functional Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.11697)** (NeurIPS 2024). **Weight-centric idea:** Extends neural functional equivariance to monomial transformations. **Potential WSP inspiration:** A portable program should not confuse harmless rescaling with a real capability change.
entries.render_zh: - **[Monomial Matrix Group Equivariant Neural Functional Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.11697)**（NeurIPS 2024）。**核心思路：**将神经泛函的等变性扩展到单项矩阵群变换。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**程序不应把无害的缩放重参数化误认为能力变化。

entries.title: Scale Equivariant Graph Metanetworks
entries.render_en: - **[Scale Equivariant Graph Metanetworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10685)** (NeurIPS 2024). **Weight-centric idea:** Models networks as graphs while respecting scale transformations. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Use structured, scale-aware signatures for identifying reusable edit sites.
entries.render_zh: - **[Scale Equivariant Graph Metanetworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10685)**（NeurIPS 2024）。**核心思路：**以图结构处理网络，并考虑缩放等变性。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**可考虑缩放感知的结构签名定位可复用编辑位点。

entries.title: Predicting Neural Network Accuracy from Weights
entries.render_en: - **[Predicting Neural Network Accuracy from Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.11448)** (2020 preprint). **Weight-centric idea:** Predicts model accuracy from weight statistics without evaluating on task inputs. **Potential WSP inspiration:** A concrete precedent for weight-only inspection; generalization to other model families must be tested.
entries.render_zh: - **[Predicting Neural Network Accuracy from Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.11448)**（2020 preprint）。**核心思路：**从参数统计量预测模型精度，不需要执行原任务。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**为纯权重读取提供可检验的先例，但跨模型泛化仍需验证。
entries.idea_en: Predicts model accuracy from weight statistics without evaluating on task inputs.
entries.idea_zh: 从参数统计量预测模型精度，不需要执行原任务。
entries.inspiration_en: A concrete precedent for weight-only inspection; generalization to other model families must be tested.
entries.inspiration_zh: 为纯权重读取提供可检验的先例，但跨模型泛化仍需验证。

entries.title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning on Neural Network Weights for Model Characteristic Prediction
entries.render_en: - **[Self-Supervised Representation Learning on Neural Network Weights for Model Characteristic Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.15288)** (NeurIPS 2021). **Weight-centric idea:** Learns model-level representations from populations of weights. **Potential WSP inspiration:** A possible alternative to directly giving an LLM raw tensors for edit localization and model profiling.
entries.render_zh: - **[Self-Supervised Representation Learning on Neural Network Weights for Model Characteristic Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.15288)**（NeurIPS 2021）。**核心思路：**从多个已训练网络的参数中学习模型级表征。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**可能为编辑位置检索与网络画像提供比原始张量更合适的输入。

entries.inspiration_en: A possible alternative to directly giving an LLM raw tensors for edit localization and model profiling.

entries.title: Hyper-Representations as Generative Models: Sampling Unseen Neural Network Weights
entries.render_en: - **[Hyper-Representations as Generative Models: Sampling Unseen Neural Network Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.14733)** (NeurIPS 2022). **Weight-centric idea:** Uses learned weight embeddings to sample new network parameters. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Connects model-zoo knowledge to reusable parameter priors, while remaining a trained generator rather than direct WSP.
entries.render_zh: - **[Hyper-Representations as Generative Models: Sampling Unseen Neural Network Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.14733)**（NeurIPS 2022）。**核心思路：**利用学习到的权重表征生成新的网络参数。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**启发从模型群体中提炼可复用先验；它属于训练式生成器，而不是直接 WSP。

entries.title: Classifying the classifier: dissecting the weight space of neural networks
entries.render_en: - **[Classifying the classifier: dissecting the weight space of neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.05688)** (ECAI 2020). **Weight-centric idea:** Uses meta-classifiers on weight snapshots to infer training and model properties. **Potential WSP inspiration:** A baseline for asking which properties are actually recoverable from parameters alone.
entries.render_zh: - **[Classifying the classifier: dissecting the weight space of neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.05688)**（ECAI 2020）。**核心思路：**利用权重快照上的元分类器识别网络训练与模型属性。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**为纯权重读取的可恢复信息提供基础对照。
entries.idea_en: Uses meta-classifiers on weight snapshots to infer training and model properties.

entries.title: Predicting trends in the quality of state-of-the-art neural networks without access to training or testing data
entries.render_en: - **[Predicting trends in the quality of state-of-the-art neural networks without access to training or testing data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.06716)** (Nature Communications 2021). **Weight-centric idea:** Estimates checkpoint quality from spectral and heavy-tailed weight statistics. **Potential WSP inspiration:** Weight-only diagnostics may help screen risky edits, but cannot substitute for behavior tests.
entries.render_zh: - **[Predicting trends in the quality of state-of-the-art neural networks without access to training or testing data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.06716)**（Nature Communications 2021）。**核心思路：**从谱统计与重尾特征估计模型质量，无需原训练集或测试集。 **对未来权重编程的启发：**可用于编辑前后的参数诊断，但不能替代行为评测。

entries.title: Graph Neural Networks for Learning Equivariant Representations of Neural Networks
